svg.title: Vale's valid authority is rejected while Ananya continues treating the patient.
svg.desc: A blank jurisdiction rejection separates Vale's tablet from the clinic line. Vale states that the authority is valid; Ananya, still monitoring the patient, replies that the patient is valid too.
svg.text: Page 46, panel 2 · Tight split view between Vale's tablet and the clinic line

text.tspan: The Grid rejects Vale's emergency authorisation
because its jurisdiction cannot be matched.
